review_evidence: Tutorials/Solutions/05SequenceLimits.lean and related files define Limit/SeqLimit-style notions and prove limit inequalities and convergence results.

Tutorials/Solutions/06SubSequences.lean defines CauchySequence and proves subsequence/cluster-point results; Tutorials/TutoLib.lean defines NonDecreasing, EvenFun, OddFun, and SeqLimit with supporting theorems.
The Exercises tree mirrors mathematical statements intended for proof, so tutorial/exercise status does not make the formal content dispensable from prior-art search.
summary: Retain tutorials4 because both exercises and solutions contain substantive formal mathematics on limits, subsequences, order, continuity, and elementary logic.
